entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No.173 of 2024, pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Sinapali arising out of Sinapali P.S. Case No. 175 of 2024 for commission of the alleged offence under Section 376(2)(n)/366 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Sessions Judge, Nuapada by order dated 18.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 09.05.2024 and as charge sheet has been filed on 30.06.2024, the Petitioner may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. Statement of the victim.
8.
Considering the same, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
10. It is directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the informant and her family.
11. It shall be open to the informant/Prosecution to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat perception.
12. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH)
